Environmental Violations Administrative Monetary Penalties ActRegulations Amending Certain Department of the Environment RegulationsRegulations Amending Certain Department of the Environment Regulations in order to (1) enable the domestic measures required for Canada to ratify the Amendment to the Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal (Ban Amendment) which would prohibit exports of most Hazardous Waste (HW) and Hazardous Recyclable Material (HRM) to non-Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development countries and would modify the definitions of HW to allow for the assessment of whether something is a waste using certain characteristics; and (2) make consequential amendments to Regulations Designating Regulatory Provisions for Purposes of Enforcement (Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999) and to the Environmental Violations Administrative Monetary Penalties Regulations to designate provisions for enforcement purposes.Registration: SOR/2026-0174 Publication Date: 2026-08-26
act:
Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999
Environmental Violations Administrative Monetary Penalties Act
subject: Regulations Amending Certain Department of the Environment Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending Certain Department of the Environment Regulations in order to (1) enable the domestic measures required for Canada to ratify the Amendment to the Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal (Ban Amendment) which would prohibit exports of most Hazardous Waste (HW) and Hazardous Recyclable Material (HRM) to non-Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development countries and would modify the definitions of HW to allow for the assessment of whether something is a waste using certain characteristics; and (2) make consequential amendments to Regulations Designating Regulatory Provisions for Purposes of Enforcement (Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999) and to the Environmental Violations Administrative Monetary Penalties Regulations to designate provisions for enforcement purposes.
